sources.title: JuristIQ | Juristic
sources.snippet: JuristIQ reasons across your entire workspace: documents, timelines, structures, and workflows. Ask about any part of the matter and the answer draws on all of it. Every AI output links back to the evidence it drew from. Click any claim to see the source document, paragraph, and page. Verify and cite before it reaches a client.
